name: Taquería
note: Warm cream storefront with one chile-red accent.
thesis: A family taquería as a warm, low-density light storefront: cream paper, espresso-brown sans type set heavy and tight, one chile-red accent doing every job (CTAs, prices, eyebrows, stat numbers), sand hairlines on white cards, and food drawn entirely with emoji in tinted rounded tiles — friendly and confident, zero photography.

tokens.bg: #FAF4EA warm cream page; cards #fff; tinted tiles/panels #F6EAD8; footer band #F4EAD9; sticky header rgba(250,244,234,0.9) + backdrop-filter blur(10px); today-row tint #FDF4E5
tokens.fg: #2C211A espresso brown; secondary #6B5A4A; descriptions/labels #7A6858; hints + mono hours #9A8873; footer muted #8A7563; modal body #4A3A2E
tokens.accent: #D6482B chile red (hover #C23E23) — CTAs, prices, eyebrows, stat numbers, the modal add-to-order; tag-pill support colors ride per-item data: #F3A712 amber (Friday only), #3F7D3A green (Vegetarian), #B3352E dark red (Weekends)
tokens.fontDisplay: var(--font-sans) at weight 800 with tight negative tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em); hero clamp(2.4rem, 6.2vw, 66px) at line-height 1.02, story h2 clamps to 36px, section h2s var(--text-3xl) — no serif anywhere
tokens.fontMono: var(--font-mono) used exactly once — the schedule hours column (var(--text-sm), #9A8873) — a single timetable tell against the all-sans page
tokens.radius: 12–16px dominant: cards 16px, modal 18px, buttons 10–12px, emoji tiles 12–14px, stat cards 14px, tag pills and ingredient chips 999px
tokens.border: 1px #ECDFCB sand on every card/button/header/footer edge; lighter #F3E9D9 for schedule row dividers; borders always hairline, depth comes from the warm hover shadow instead
tokens.motion: menu cards lift on hover: transform .2s + box-shadow .2s to translateY(-4px) with a warm colored shadow 0 16px 32px -16px rgba(120,60,20,0.3); sticky header blurs the scroll behind it; everything else is 150ms color/border fades; honor prefers-reduced-motion by dropping the lift

layout: Single-column storefront capped at 1140px with 28px side padding under a sticky frosted-cream glass header (brand lockup left, anchor nav + red pill CTA right). Flow: centered hero (72px top pad — emoji eyebrow, huge tight-tracked headline capped at 760px, 480px subcopy, two pill CTAs), a 3-column menu card grid (gap 18px, collapsing 3→2→1), a 50/50 story band (copy left, 2x2 stat-card grid right) opened by a 1px sand top border, a schedule list inside one bordered rounded-16px white card, and a darker sand footer band. Density is low and airy — 40–72px section padding, 18–20px card padding. The only layered surface is a fixed 440px taco-detail modal with a warm brown scrim.

sections.name: sticky header
sections.what: Brand lockup ('Mom-n-Pops' bold 20px + 'Taquería' in accent red 13px) linking to the collection hub, right-aligned anchor nav (Menu / Story / Find us) and a red 'Find the truck' pill.
sections.restyle: Header stays hand-rolled frosted glass — rgba cream bg + backdrop-blur(10px) + 1px sand bottom border, sticky under the gallery frame (z-index < 30) — an audit-sanctioned decorative-chrome exception (adopting Navbar here would regress the frosted glass, the 1140px centering, and the mobile-only pill behaviour, and it is flagged lower-priority). The brand lockup is an Inertia Link back to the collection hub; the pill CTA is a Button squeezed to 9px/16px padding and 10px radius, red fill.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Centered stack: uppercase letterspaced eyebrow ('🌮 Family food truck · Milwaukee · Est. 2026'), the 66px/1.02 weight-800 headline 'Tacos the way Rosa's abuela made them.', 480px subcopy, and two pill buttons — red filled 'View the menu', white sand-outlined 'This week's stops'.
sections.restyle: Headline is a Heading (as=h1) restyled to the clamp(2.4rem,6.2vw,66px) display face (weight 800, -0.03em, espresso ink — overriding the library's zinc/text-lg defaults); subcopy is a Text (as=p) at var(--text-xl) warm brown. Buttons flattened to warm pills: 12px radius, 13px/24px padding, no shadow; primary = chile-red fill darkening on hover, secondary = white with sand border turning red on hover. Eyebrow stays a hand-rolled label with 0.14em tracking + accent red.

sections.name: menu grid
sections.what: Section header row (Heading h2 'The menu' + muted 'tap a taco for the full story' hint), then a 3-column grid of 6 clickable white cards: 44px emoji tile on #F6EAD8, optional colored tag pill, name + red price on one baseline row, one-line description. The whole card opens the detail modal.
sections.restyle: Each menu tile is a Card (variant=outlined, padding=none) worn as an accessible role="button" (tabIndex 0 + Enter/Space handler = the modal trigger), restyled to override the library's rounded-lg/bg-white/border-zinc chrome → 16px radius, sand border, 20px padding, focus-visible ring, hover lift translateY(-4px) + warm 32px shadow. The section heading is a Heading (h2). Badge becomes the tag pill: 11px/700 white text, radius 999, border 0, background driven per-item from data (tagBg) via inline style — Most loved / Friday only / Vegetarian / Weekends.

sections.name: story band
sections.what: 50/50 band opened by a sand top border: left is eyebrow ('Our story') + Heading 'Two parents, one griddle, a whole lot of Milwaukee.' + Text paragraph; right is a 2x2 grid of white stat cards — big red 30px number over a small muted label (6 tacos from $4 · est. 2026 · 3 salsas · ∞ free chips*).
sections.restyle: The four stat tiles are Cards (variant=outlined, padding=none) restyled to 14px radius + sand border + 18px padding; stat values styled exactly like menu prices (weight 800, chile red, -0.02em) so the band rhymes with the menu. Headline is a Heading (h2), body a Text (p). The '∞ free chips*' asterisk label gets a dotted underline + Tooltip carrying the fine print ('one basket per order — Rosa's rule').

sections.name: schedule
sections.what: Heading 'Find the truck', then one bordered rounded-16px white card of six weekday rows: bold day (120px), muted place, right-aligned mono hours; rows divided by 1px #F3E9D9. After hydration the current weekday row tints warm and gains a red 'Today' Badge.
sections.restyle: The route is a react-fancy Table (Table.Body / Table.Row / Table.Cell, no header row) restyled to the hairline card: the wrapper div forced to 16px radius + sand border (overriding rounded-lg/border-zinc), the default zinc divide-y recolored to warm #F3E9D9, the zinc row hover killed, cells re-padded 14px/22px with the day cell fixed at 120px and the hours cell right-aligned mono #9A8873 (the page's single typographic contrast). 'Today' is a Badge shrunk to a 10px uppercase red pill — computed in useEffect so SSR first paint stays deterministic.

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Darker sand (#F4EAD9) band with sand top border: bold brand name, anti-scrape email ('hello@momnpops.truck') + instagram handle, and '© 2026 · Rosa & Sal · Milwaukee' in a space-between wrap row, plus a tiny mono demo-folio line.
sections.restyle: Flat one-liner footer, no link columns; all hand-rolled.

sections.name: taco detail modal
sections.what: Clicking any menu card opens a 440px cream modal: tinted #F6EAD8 header with a 56px white emoji tile + 26px name + red price, then the long description, white ingredient-chip pills with sand borders, and a full-width red 'Add to order · $x.xx' button. Scrim, Escape, and the add button all dismiss (no real cart — a themed dismiss).
sections.restyle: Modal panel forced to cream #FAF4EA, radius 18px, border 0, deep warm shadow 0 30px 70px -20px rgba(44,33,26,0.4), max-width 440px; the library backdrop recolored to rgba(44,33,26,0.5) with no blur via a :has() selector on the prefixed panel class. The name is a Heading (h2) and the long copy a Text (p), both re-scoped under the portaled .mptacos-modal panel to override the library zinc/size defaults. Badges become white ingredient chips (sand border, radius 999). The full-width dismiss is a Button. Selected-item state IS the modal state: sel: MenuItem | null plus a separate open flag so content survives the exit animation.

palette.restyle: Two reads, both variant=outlined + padding=none with the library's rounded-lg/bg-white/border-zinc chrome overridden under .mptacos-root: (1) the 6 menu tiles — 16px radius, 1px sand border, 20px padding, worn as an accessible role="button" (tabIndex 0 + Enter/Space handler) so the whole card opens the detail Modal, with a focus-visible ring and a hover lift translateY(-4px) + warm 0 16px 32px -16px shadow; (2) the 4 story stat tiles — 14px radius, sand border, 18px padding, big chile-red weight-800 number over a muted label.

The six-row weekly route (Table.Body / Table.Row / Table.Cell, no header row) restyled to the single hairline card: wrapper div forced to 16px radius + sand border, the default divide-y row hairline recolored to warm #F3E9D9, the zinc row hover killed, cells re-padded 14px/22px, day cell fixed 120px bold espresso, place cell muted, hours cell right-aligned var(--font-mono) #9A8873 (the page's one typographic contrast). The active row tints #FDF4E5 and carries the 'Today' Badge.

Warm pill: radius 12px (10px in the header), sans weight 600, no shadow. Primary = chile-red #D6482B fill darkening to #C23E23 on hover; secondary = white fill + 1px sand border flipping text/border to red on hover; in the modal it stretches full-width as 'Add to order'.

Three reads: (1) menu tag pill — 11px/700 white on a per-item data-driven background (inline style from tagBg), radius 999, no border; (2) ingredient chip — white pill, sand border, #5A4A3C text, 6px/12px padding; (3) 'Today' marker — 10px uppercase red pill in the schedule Table row.

The richest surface on the page: cream panel, 18px radius, zero border, deep warm 70px shadow, 440px cap; header band tinted #F6EAD8 holding a 56px white emoji tile; backdrop recolored to warm brown rgba(44,33,26,0.5) without blur. Controlled entirely by the selected menu item.

The display faces (as=h1 hero, as=h2 section + modal titles) re-scoped under .mptacos-root / .mptacos-modal to override the library's zinc color + size/weight presets → weight 800, tight negative tracking, espresso ink; hero clamps to 66px, section h2s to var(--text-3xl), story h2 to 36px, modal name to 26px.

The prose (hero subcopy var(--text-xl), story body var(--text-lg), modal long description) as Text (as=p) re-scoped to override the zinc color into the warm-brown secondary inks; menu-card one-liners stay plain

to mirror the calibration reference.
Fine print for the '∞ free chips*' stat — small text, dotted-underline cursor-help trigger; the only floating helper on the page.
Only the brand lockup — espresso text with the red 'Taquería' descriptor; nav items are plain in-page anchors that darken on hover.

contentArchetype: A family food-truck storefront: hero promise ('Tacos the way Rosa's abuela made them.'), a six-item priced menu with per-item tags and full ingredient stories (Al Pastor $4.50 'Most loved' → Barbacoa $5.50 'Weekends'), a founder story band (Rosa runs the comal, Sal runs the window, the kids run the register) with four playful stats ending in '∞ free chips*', a six-day Milwaukee route timetable (Cathedral Square → South Shore Farmers Market), and a one-line contact footer. Everything a taco truck needs, nothing it doesn't.
remix: Swap the chile red for any single saturated food accent (salsa-verde green, cochinita orange, horchata brown) and re-tint the cream toward that hue to reskin the whole truck. The load-bearing moves: (1) one warm paper bg + white cards separated only by sand hairlines, (2) a single accent doing CTAs, prices, eyebrows, and stat numbers so money and action share a color, (3) heavy tight-tracked sans display against airy 40–72px section padding, (4) emoji-in-tinted-tile as the entire food art system (44px grid, 56px modal — no photos to shoot), (5) whole-card modal triggers with a warm colored hover lift. Blend toward 'editorial' by trading the sans for a serif and squaring the radii; blend toward a data surface by letting the schedule card grow into a Table or the menu into a configurator. Any Fancy primitive joins by dropping to radius 999 or 12–16px, taking the sand border, and reserving color for the one accent.
